# IBuyAndBurn
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/IBuyAndBurn.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IBuyAndBurnEvents](../events/i-buy-and-burn-events.md), [IBuyAndBurnErrors](../errors/i-buy-and-burn-errors.md)

**Title:**
IBuyAndBurn

Interface for the BuyAndBurn contract, which manages token auctions and burns SUMMER tokens


## Functions
### startAuction

Starts a new auction for a specified token

**Notes:**
- override: Implements the startAuction function from IBuyAndBurn

- internal-logic: 
- Checks if there's already an ongoing auction for the token
- Creates a new auction using the current balance of the token
- Stores the auction data and updates the ongoingAuctions mapping

- effects: 
- Creates a new auction
- Updates the ongoingAuctions mapping
- Emits a BuyAndBurnAuctionStarted event

- security-considerations: 
- Only callable by the governor
- Ensure the contract has the necessary token balance before starting the auction


```solidity
function startAuction(address tokenToAuction) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`tokenToAuction`|`address`|The address of the token to be auctioned|


### buyTokens

Allows users to buy tokens from an ongoing auction

**Notes:**
- override: Implements the buyTokens function from IBuyAndBurn

- internal-logic: 
- Retrieves the auction data
- Calls the buyTokens function of the DutchAuctionLibrary
- Updates the amount of SUMMER raised in the auction
- Settles the auction if all tokens are sold

- effects: 
- Transfers tokens between the buyer and the contract
- Updates the auction state
- May settle the auction if all tokens are sold

- security-considerations: 
- Ensure proper token transfers and balance updates
- Handle potential reentrancy risks


```solidity
function buyTokens(uint256 auctionId, uint256 amount) external returns (uint256 summerAmount);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`auctionId`|`uint256`|The ID of the auction|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens to buy|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`summerAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of SUMMER tokens required to purchase the specified amount of auction tokens|


### finalizeAuction

Finalizes an auction after its end time

**Notes:**
- override: Implements the finalizeAuction function from IBuyAndBurn

- internal-logic: 
- Retrieves the auction data
- Calls the finalizeAuction function of the DutchAuctionLibrary
- Settles the auction
- if all tokens are sold, the auction is settled automatically

- effects: 
- Updates the auction state
- Burns SUMMER tokens
- Cleans up auction-related state

- security-considerations: 
- Ensure proper handling of remaining tokens and raised funds


```solidity
function finalizeAuction(uint256 auctionId) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`auctionId`|`uint256`|The ID of the auction to finalize|
